subject: Promo merch — short run + split shipping plan for VectorCon booth
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Kate Turner <kate@brightlinepromos.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Promo merch — short run + split shipping plan for VectorCon booth

Hi Kate,

Quick one — VectorCon (Aug 12-14) is confirmed and we need a short-run batch of promo merch for the booth. Scope is tight so we need a plan that hits these constraints:

- Total units: 1,200 pieces across 4 SKUs (listed in attached spec).
- Short run pricing/premium ok but we need ETA: ship from you by 07/31 to reach our US warehouse (East and West split).
- Split shipment: 60% to Redwood West warehouse (San Leandro) and 40% to Redwood East (Newark NJ).
- Pack counts: please provide carton qty, weight, and palletization for both destinations.
- Customs: include HS codes and any export docs if you cross borders.

Attached is redwood_promo_spec_v1.pdf with artwork proofs and per-unit assortments. Please send a line-item quote (unit cost, setup, rush fee, shipping estimates), lead time, and whether any items are at risk of backorder.

We’ll need a physical sample of the embroidered cap and the tech pouch by 07/20 for an approvals check. If you can’t hit that, propose an alternative.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_promo_spec_v1.pdf (pdf, 1.8MB)]

From: Kate Turner <kate@brightlinepromos.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T11:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Promo merch — short run + split shipping plan for VectorCon booth

Hi Priyom — thanks for the spec. We can handle a short run but I want to call out two risk items up front: the embroidered cap (SKU A) depends on a limited-thread color we ordered last week and the silicone cable tie (SKU C) is experiencing a 10–14 day supplier delay.

Preliminary numbers (all EXW):
- SKU A (embroidered cap): 1,200 units — $4.20 ea (set up $65) — ETA to ship from vendor 07/28 (if thread arrives on 07/16).
- SKU B (branded tee): 1,200 units — $3.40 ea (no setup) — ETA 07/25.
- SKU C (silicone cable tie): 1,200 units — $1.10 ea (set up $25) — ETA 08/08 (risk of late).
- SKU D (tech pouch): 300 units — $6.50 ea (set up $80) — ETA 07/26.

Rush fees: we can prioritize the cap and tee to meet 07/31 ship if you accept a 12% rush premium on those SKUs.

Shipping estimates to split addresses (LTL, door delivery):
- West (San Leandro): freight est $420 (2 pallets)
- East (Newark): freight est $520 (1 pallet)

I attached a detailed line quote (brightline_quote_v5.xlsx). We suggest swapping SKU C for a temporary cord (SKU C-alt) at $1.30 ea with similar look; it’s in stock and would meet the deadlines.

If you want to proceed, please confirm which items to substitute and whether you approve rush fees. Sample timeline: ship physical sample for cap + pouch by 07/20 via FedEx 2-day if approved today.

Best,
Kate Turner
Account Lead | Brightline Promotions
Brightline Promotions
[Attachment: brightline_quote_v5.xlsx (xlsx, 54KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Kate Turner <kate@brightlinepromos.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T13:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo merch — short run + split shipping plan for VectorCon booth

Thanks Kate — copy and appreciate the alternative for SKU C. A few quick asks from procurement/ops:

- Can you send a per-carton breakdown (units/carton), gross weight, and dims so we can price receiving and drayage?
- Please include the HS codes and confirm whether you’re shipping from CA or overseas (we need paperwork lead times).
- Marissa: budget check — total landed estimate including rush was higher than we planned. Priyom, can you confirm priorities? If we drop the cable tie and keep an extra 200 tees instead, we stay closer to budget.

Laura — can you confirm receiving windows at the two warehouses? We need them to accept a pallet arrival between 08/01–08/05.

Marissa
Events Ops Lead | Redwood Inference

On Jul 13, 2026, at 11:02 AM, Kate Turner <kate@brightlinepromos.com> wrote:
> (quoted vendor reply)
> [Attachment: brightline_quote_v5.xlsx]

From: Kate Turner <kate@brightlinepromos.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Promo merch — short run + split shipping plan for VectorCon booth

Quick update after checking with production — the silicone cable tie (SKU C) is indeed backordered until 08/09 due to a resin batch delay. We can:

Option 1 (recommended): Substitute SKU C with the cord (SKU C-alt) at $1.30 ea, in stock, ships with main order.
Option 2: Produce SKU C separately and ship to East only (smaller pallet) once stock arrives — additional $95 sorting fee and $75 expedited freight.

I’ve attached a revised quote with the substitution (revised_quote_v5b.xlsx). If we receive approval by EOD 07/20 we can lock the 07/28–07/31 production window and ship by 07/31 with the West/East split you requested.

Also note: embroidered cap thread ETA is now confirmed for 07/17 which keeps cap timing intact. Physical sample for cap + pouch can go out tomorrow (07/19) for 2-day and should reach you 07/21.

Kate

[Attachment: revised_quote_v5b.xlsx]

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Kate Turner <kate@brightlinepromos.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo merch — short run + split shipping plan for VectorCon booth

Kate / team — thanks for the fast turn. We approve Option 1 (substitute SKU C with SKU C-alt) and accept the 12% rush on caps + tees. Confirming final PO and split ship instructions below:

Final quantities:
- SKU A (cap): 1,200
- SKU B (tee): 1,400 (increase 200 in place of cable tie)
- SKU C-alt (cord substitute): 1,200
- SKU D (tech pouch): 300

Shipping split (door delivery LTL):
- Redwood West, San Leandro Warehouse (60%): 720 units total — 2 pallets — contact: Receiving@redwood-west.example (appts required 08/01–08/03)
- Redwood East, Newark NJ (40%): 480 units total — 1 pallet — contact: Receiving@redwood-east.example (appts required 08/02–08/05)

Payment / PO: Please consider this email the final approval. We’ve attached signed_PO_Redwood_07202026.pdf with PO # RFI-0720-001. Payment terms: Net 30. Please send final packing list + carrier/pro number once shipped.

Also — please ship the physical sample for cap + pouch as discussed (tracking requested). HubSpot deal HS-46218 should be updated with the quote id QB-2026-0897.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signed_PO_Redwood_07202026.pdf]
Notes: All messages contain realistic quoting headers, inline replies, and referenced attachments. Quoted vendor replies have been preserved with abbreviated excerpts where appropriate.
